text_block_list.text: One day, when I went out to buy supplies――

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm just checkin' out the trendy spots
my classmates told me about!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I ain't been around here much, though,
so I ended up totally lost...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I brought a map, but I feel like
I've been walking in circles around the same spot for a while now~.

text_block_list.text: I took a look at the map Yukino Bijin was holding and pointed out our current location and her destination.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aah~, so I was heading in the complete opposite direction!
That was a close one~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City folks sure are amazin', I tell ya~.
Thanks to you, I'm saved.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be takin' my leave~.

Watching Yukino Bijin explore unfamiliar streets with map in hand,
I thought walking all around town might make for good endurance training.
I recommended my favorite map app to Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea something so convenient existed~.
It even shows the route all the way to the destination!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With an app, you'll never get lost
anywhere in the big city, will you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be takin' my leave~.
Streamlining things allows one to reach their destination swiftly. I thought the same could be said for pacing a race.
